notes.onboardSubtitle: Set up your school's grading system

edt.stepHint1: Configure your school's class hours. Slots are calculated automatically from the start time, end time and lesson duration.
edt.stepHint2: Set the number of hours per week for each subject and level. The total must not exceed the number of slots available in your time grid.
edt.stepHint3: Assign each teacher to the subjects and classes they teach. The tool automatically checks that no teacher is overloaded.
edt.stepHint4: Generate the timetable from your settings. The algorithm schedules lessons automatically and flags conflicts.
edt.levelHoursHint: Some levels have different days or hours (e.g. Saturday for exam classes).

mia.edtHint: Enter or scan your timetable. MIAPO+ will suggest revising the day before each class.
mia.edtVeilleSub: Tomorrow ({jour}) you have these classes — revise them tonight.
mia.6cIntro: A short questionnaire maps your 6 competencies (creativity, critical thinking, communication, cooperation, courage, confidence) and gives you a personalised report.
mia.6cInstructions: For each statement, rate from 1 (not at all) to 5 (totally). Be honest — that's what makes the report accurate.
mia.oriIntro: MIAPO guidance works in 3 steps: 1. we assess {name}'s profile (6 competencies); 2. we cross it with the country's real fields and career paths; 3. we suggest reasoned options — never at random.
mia.oriS1Hint: The profile is set through a short 30-question questionnaire in the « 6C profile » tab — that's what makes the suggestions accurate.
mia.oriS2Hint: Suggestions will be based on the real fields, schools and career paths of the chosen destination.
mia.oriPaysNote: The guidance reference for {name}'s country ({pays}) is not available yet. In the meantime, MIAPO relies on regional (Cameroon) and international (France) benchmarks to situate fields and career paths.
mia.oriS3Idle: MIAPO combines {name}'s 6C profile, their level ({niveau}) and the real data for {pays}.
mia.oriAnalyzing: MIAPO is analysing the profile and fields…
mia.oriMobiText: Student mobility (admission, « Études en France » visa, housing, budget) needs preparation. Mobi, EDUFREM's mobility app, guides {name} step by step.
mia.oriSrcNote: Suggestions based on public data (refine with a counsellor).
mia.oriDisclaimer: These are recommendations to inform a choice, not obligations. Discuss them further with your family and school.
mia.weekAgendaSub: The revisions MIAPO suggests this week.
mia.myAgendaSub: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to see your appointments here.
